title: Hedgeye王 Felix：英伟达 rally 是死猫跳还是反转？治理问题仍存
speaker: Felix Wang

segments.en: But that said, this is a step really in the right direction for Nvidia.
segments.zh: 但话虽如此，这对英伟达来说确实是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。

segments.en: One of my biggest worries was without Jensen, for example, how do you rectify any types of issues
segments.zh: 我最大的担忧之一是，比如没有Jensen，你如何纠正任何类型的问题

segments.en: they may have with very complicated rack system deployments?
segments.zh: 他们可能面临的非常复杂的机架系统部署问题？

segments.en: And Jensen, being how close he is to the engineering process, now I feel like all of these server markets
segments.zh: 而Jensen，由于他如此接近工程流程，现在我觉得所有这些服务器市场

segments.en: will probably get a bigger boost just because they're happy to see someone they are familiar with who can recognize how to solve interesting problems in AI.
segments.zh: 可能会获得更大的提振，因为他们很高兴看到一个他们熟悉的人，能够认识到如何解决AI中有趣的问题。

segments.en: So this rally that we're seeing right now, I mean, is it just a relief rally?
segments.zh: 那么我们现在看到的这轮上涨，只是缓解性反弹吗？

segments.en: Is there more to this? I mean, how are you assessing the rest of this whole AI ecosystem now?
segments.zh: 还有更多内容吗？我的意思是，你现在如何评估整个AI生态系统的其余部分？

segments.en: I do think today obviously is a great day for Nvidia shareholder.
segments.zh: 我确实认为今天显然是英伟达股东的好日子。

segments.en: But again, there's some governance issues.
segments.zh: 但再次强调，存在一些治理问题。

segments.en: He still needs to appear in front of Congress and close doors.
segments.zh: 他仍然需要出现在国会面前并闭门会谈。

segments.en: And then there's this issue about Singapore.
segments.zh: 然后还有新加坡这个问题。

segments.en: Keep in mind, Nvidia did not break out Singapore revenues in the last quarter and they grouped it under other.
segments.zh: 记住，英伟达上季度没有单独列出新加坡收入，而是归入其他项。

segments.en: So this has become a hot topic on potential whatever you want to call it,
segments.zh: 所以这成了热门话题，关于潜在的，不管你怎么称呼，

segments.en: export control rules may be broken and so forth. But until that is kind of rectified and cleared up,
segments.zh: 出口管制规则可能被违反等等。但在那得到纠正和澄清之前，

segments.en: it's hard to kind of figure out if Nvidia really is in the clear going forward.
segments.zh: 很难判断英伟达未来是否真的没有问题。

segments.en: But at the very least, they do have their leader and found her back.
segments.zh: 但至少，他们还有自己的领导者，并且找回了她。
